text.tspan: From GRUB to an interactive shell in ring 3. The order below is the order in kernel_main().
idt_init runs early so a fault in
tss_init follows at once: a fault at
CPL 3 needs TSS.RSP0 to land on
Boot map first, kernel map second:
boot.s only needs to reach long mode;
vmm_init builds the real, narrower map
No sti before the fork: ring-3 test
probes enter and resume with IF clear,
so one early sti would not last
faults are reported from here on
map does not map firmware tables
must sit above this line. The
halts if there is no framebuffer
paging live, and a real syscall
round trip: alloc → map → unmap → free
